summarize_memory_preprocess: summarize the python memory_preprocess function that computes perfection_regret and regret_ratio columns for a DataFrame
run_score: run the python score function to compute a single memory_len score from a DataFrame grouped by memory_length
build_plot_learning: build a plot showing average return through time grouped by memory_length using plot_learning
build_plot_scale: build a regret ratio scaling plot across memory lengths using plot_scale with a learning threshold
build_plot_seeds: build an individual run return plot colored by memory_length using plot_seeds
